input: I think one thing worth doing is getting some platform content generation for platforms. not violating tos or anything but automated marketing across a variety of platforms.
task: Owner request: automated, ToS-compliant marketing content across many platforms. Built an extractive content engine for the distribution hub.

doc_friction.issue: BASE_URL (and bluesky.mjs BASE_URL) still name duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/ although the site moved to marisstella.app on 2026-10-30; links still work via redirect stubs that keep ?ref=, but cost a hop. Left for a separate change because many tests pin the old URL.
hub.test.mjs, shorts.test.mjs and launch-kit.test.mjs ran in no pull-request workflow; added them (and the new content.test.mjs) to this job.

notes: New platform/distribution/hub/content.mjs extracts a post's lead, numeric findings and stated limits verbatim and lays them out as threads (X 280, Bluesky 300, Threads/Mastodon 500), LinkedIn, Reddit (with affiliation disclosure), HN first comment, carousel slides and a video script. Draft-mode platforms get it in `pack`; new `hub.mjs kit` writes every shape; the daily distribute-hub job adds kits for the last day's posts to its uploaded artifact (files only, posts nothing). api/delegated platforms' text is unchanged (tested). Corpus check over all docs/posts: 1,456 of 1,470 yield a kit, avg 3.35 findings and 1.35 limits, 0 sentences not verbatim, 0 pieces over limit. Fixed during build: code spans losing <n> to the HTML stripper; empty description deduping every sentence away; grapheme counting cut from ~63 s to ~6 s over the corpus with an exact fast path. Local: node --test hub.test.mjs hub/content.test.mjs shorts.test.mjs launch-kit.test.mjs bluesky mastodon attribution devto hashnode: 85/85 pass; versions.mjs --check current; workflow YAML parses; new post loads (description 158, seo_title 59).
